limitations: 364 of 906 model calls failed. 53 calls PER AGENT failed with 'You've hit your session limit', so the extraction is truncated, not merely lossy.
63 of 149 studies (42%) had at least one partial agent failure.

S5 failed 75 of 169 attempts (44%). S5 supplies the direction label AND the effect size, and a missing S5 removes that study's NULL claims -- measured earlier in this project, S5 failures bias a score UPWARD because they hide nulls. The scores in this run are therefore optimistic by an unknown amount and must not be read as the effect of SCORING_MODEL v8.
S3 failed 65 of 159 attempts (41%), so population and eligibility facts are missing for many studies and invariant 7's refusals could not fire.

The session limit was exhausted by two large analysis workflows run immediately beforehand. CLAUDE.md warns against exactly this: concurrent subagent work draws on the same subscription session limit as a production extraction.
This is the FIRST run under v1.17, so it is also the first that could activate the effect-size path at all -- which makes a clean re-run the only way to measure what v8 does.
